propositions: Local git call sites contend on shared locks (.git/index.lock, HEAD.lock, packed-refs.lock) under high concurrent local use with no contention policy, causing hard failures instead of transparent retry.

Per-store advisory flock serializes rebar's own writers with bounded jittered retry/backoff on git lock signatures, absorbing transient conflicts silently and surfacing one actionable error only when timeout budget exhausted.

All index-mutating store git invocations route through _with_index_lock_retry seam, which extends retry from index.lock-only to ref/config lock conflicts and raises budget from ~2s to ~20s with jittered backoff.

Uncontended store git writes add zero latency via non-blocking advisory lock fast-path; contended paths poll with jittered sleeps bounded by configurable timeout (default ~30s) then proceed without lock or error.

Each local-only git call site is bounded by watchdog timeout (120s for txn/compact/delete/fsck, 300s for metrics) justified against local latency, or documented as deliberately unbounded with reason stated.
